page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-2xL40S is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 20 vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory. The processing power is delivered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor built on the x86_64 architecture, featuring 20 physical cores operating at 2.0 GHz with a single thread per core. This CPU allocation is shared. The server integrates two NVIDIA L40S GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a total of 96 GB of VRAM. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks indicate top-tier capabilities in single-core operations, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance, Geekbench single-core, and text processing scores all placing in the top 10%. Multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores rank in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth is also strong, with read-only and write operations consistently placing in the top 25%. In LLM inference testing, the server achieves top-tier speeds for prompt processing and text generation with a small 135M model, and strong text generation speeds with a medium 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers high resource density by combining a substantial 256.0 GB memory footprint with dual enterprise-grade GPUs. However, the shared CPU allocation and the lack of local storage represent key architectural tradeoffs that require external storage solutions. This configuration is engineered for workloads such as machine learning inference, data science, and parallel processing tasks that leverage GPU acceleration and high memory capacity.
